name: X5 Retail Group N.V.
summary: X5 Retail Group N.V. operates as a food retailer in Russia. As of December 31, 2020, the company had 17,707 company-operated stores, including 16,709 Pyaterochka proximity stores, 933 Perekrestok supermarkets, 56 Karusel hypermarkets, 4 Chizhik hard discounters, and 5 Perekrestok Vprok dark stores. It also engages in wholesale operations and online retail business, as well as providing franchise and other services. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
